payload.artist_html: Abigail Caron, Vishruth Venkataraman, Kristen Tietjen and Michael Coates
payload.description_html: Lateral comparative drawing of fossil and extant neurocrania. A, Phoebeannaia mossae sp. nov. (NHMUK PV P 10419a & b). B, Kansasiella eatoni (composite of FMNH UF464 and FMNH UF462). C, Pteronisculus magnus (UCMZ GN287) adapted from Coates (1998). D, Lawrenciella sp. (AMNH FF 20852) adapted from Pradel et al. (2016). E, Polypterus senegalus 32 mm adapted from Bjerring (1991). F, Polypterus ornatipinnis (FMNH 117746) adult adapted from Lemberg et al. (2021). G, Acipenser stellatus (FMNH Z87365). Parasphenoid stippled where shown (B, C, F).
